name: Taqueria La Perla De Jalisco
tagline: Street tacos, tostadas and mojarra frita on FM 1960 in Houston.
about: Taqueria La Perla De Jalisco is at 5020 FM 1960 Rd W in Houston, serving breakfast, tacos and Mexican seafood. One longtime regular says they've been coming for over 12 years.
Diners mention the street tacos, tostadas, mojarra frita, green salsa and flan. Curbside pickup is available.
sources: Rating and favorites: Uber Eats and Restaurantji listings
conflicts: Restaurantji shows 4.2 from 293 ratings; Yelp shows about 4.0 from 180 reviews.
